newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to dawdle, barrier at 103.47.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to dawdle, barrier at 103.47.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE are in a consolidation phase and are unlikely to move outside a small range on Thursday, technical analysts said.
"We have resistance immediately below 103.50, at 103.47," said Elli Gifford, independent technical analyst near Cambridge.
"That level has held on an intraday basis on several occasions."
The September Bund future was trading at 103.36 at 0645 GMT, down 0.05.
Support also lies close to current levels, Gifford said, stretching between 103.30 and 103.25.
"There is no absolute level that I would choose to pick there," Gifford said.
Martin Siegert, derivatives portfolio manager at Landesgirokasse in Stuttgart, said the 103.19-103.20 area was the pivot level for Thursday's session.

"For some days we have been looking for a bigger consolidation. We can see a correction to 103.19, but first we have to break the 103.32 level, trendline near-term support," he said. The contract reached a session low of 103.33 earlier.
From 103.19-20, the direction of the contract was unclear, Siegert said.
"There are two possibilities," said Siegert. "One is that we break the 103.52 high, and the other is that we go deeper down to 102.68."
The September future made a contract high on daily charts of 103.52 on July 23. It recorded a low of 102.68 on July 16, before the recent uptrend.
Gifford said the contract was unlikely to fall too far on Thursday. "It is not in any serious danger. I cannot see much happening here right now."
At the short end, December Euromarks were one basis point higher at 96.55.
